「先办打工度假入境、到了再转其他身份」在本项目上不成立：名额按护照签发地分配，中: Entering on a working holiday and then switching status does not work for this programme. Quotas are allocated by passport of issue: mainland Chinese passport holders have no quota, Taiwan gets 400, and Hong Kong's quota is not published. The applicant must lodge directly with the competent authority for that passport, so a third-country identity cannot be used to take a quota. Any agency claiming it can "secure a quota" is promising something the authorities have not opened.
作为对照样本的价值：爱尔兰的 WHV 是「按护照签发地给额度」的典型，与日本（3: Why it is kept as a contrast case: Ireland's WHV is the textbook example of quotas allocated by passport of issue, in the same family as Japan (a 33-country/region list) and South Korea (28 countries/regions). Eligibility turns on whether your passport of issue is on the list, not on your education, funds or language ability — none of those are even examined for people outside the list.
